msg: Every gnome has a different value 0-9 based on their colour. It seems that group 1 (red, blue, pink, purple) have similar values and group 2 (brown, yellow, orange, green) have similar values. One group will start with higher values and go down whilst the other group starts with lower values and increases. For example, group 1 starts with high values and group 2 with low values. After so many rounds, group 1 will then have low values and group 1 high. This fluctuates during the game.
